function starSurfaceFor(THREE, def): Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap> | undefined

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/star-surface.ts:54

Generates a seeded equirect photosphere texture for a luminous body — hundreds of small offset granulation cells modulate the star's tint so the sphere reads as a boiling photosphere (convection granules) rather than a smooth egg; the fresnel material modulates this map into the limb tint at grazing angles, which stands in for limb darkening + refraction. Returns undefined without a 2d context.

Parameters

THREE

__module

The three.js module.

def

SFBodyDef

Star def (color = photosphere tint, id = seed).

Returns

Texture<unknown, TextureEventMap> | undefined

A CanvasTexture for the glow-sphere's color modulate, or undefined.
